philippines.title: Mom's Closet Manila unveils its latest vintage luxury collection
philippines.description:
Vintage luxury lovers and collectors have something new to check out as Mom’s Closet Manila rolls out its latest collection of authentic vintage and unused designer costume jewelry sourced from Japan. The curated selection features timeless pieces that continue to attract fashion enthusiasts and collectors alike. The collection comes from trusted luxury resale markets in Tokyo and Osaka, where Japan’s secondhand luxury industry is known for its strict authentication process and transparent retail practices. philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Sy family-backed Belle Corp. posted a 22 percent rise in first-half net income as stronger gaming revenues and lower financing costs offset higher expenses. philippines.title: Talisay City's boxing pride Fajardo turns pro, joins Sanman Boxing
philippines.description:
CEBU CITY, Philippines — One of Cebu’s most accomplished amateur boxers, Mark Ashley Fajardo, has officially turned professional after signing with Jim Claude Manangquil’s Sanman Boxing in partnership with Roy Cuico. The hard-hitting Talisay City native, a Southeast Asian (SEA) Games bronze medalist and one of the region’s most decorated amateur fighters, will campaign in the super lightweight and welterweight divisions. He is expected to make his professional debut in October. “Naka-desisyon ko nga sugdan na nako akong pro boxing journey kay gusto ko mahimong world champion, in God’s will, puhon,” Fajardo said.
